Made procgen naked beach spawns fairer to cover more areas of beach with less strict checks
* Also fixes party spawns not working on first spawn; reset pooled team spawn state
* Reduced monument check from 50m to 30m using painted topology, not boxes
* Allow spawning on jungle/desert coastline if it is 50m away from temperate/tundra

* Skip spawnpoints that are >0.5 underwater (fixes existing rare bugs)
